text:
If you’re stepping out for lunch or a walk, Burlington is delivering the pleasant version of Friday so far: clear skies, a cool 61, and a light west-northwest breeze. The sun should carry us into the low 70s this afternoon, with the lake staying friendly, north winds around 5 to 10 knots and waves a foot or less. Clouds build after sunset, but tonight looks dry, mostly cloudy, and cool, with temperatures sliding toward the low 50s.

Saturday is the less settled day. Expect a cloudy, breezy afternoon in the upper 60s, though the models disagree on how warm we get, and showers become more likely after 8 in the evening. The lake gets choppier too, with waves up to 3 feet and stronger north winds Saturday night. Enjoy the sunshine through late afternoon, keep tonight’s plans light, and don’t count on a smooth Saturday night on the water.
